thread:
Rae (Mktg): noticed a cluster of unassigned APAC leads overnight in the handoff dashboard (~80).
Tom - SalesOps: thanks for flagging. was it enrichment lag or owner-rule?
Yvonne CS: majority show enrichment timing out; owner rule needs company.segment to pick the right pool so it skipped.
Leela Eng: our enrich lambda scales down in low-traffic windows; we can bump briefly but prefer a deterministic fallback to avoid leaving leads unowned.
Rae (Mktg): proposal: add a short APAC "night-pool" fallback after 12 minutes for Asia/Oceania timezones so SDRs have ownership.
Tom - SalesOps: agree. workflow: Delay 12m -> If contact.owner IS_EMPTY AND timezone IN APAC -> assign owner = "APAC-night-fallback" and set property inbound_fallback = "true"; add fallback_source = "hs_workflow".
Yvonne CS: add segmentation on revenue band so enterprise leads go to APAC-ent-night and trials to APAC-smb-night. Tag fallback leads so they don't impact immediate conversion dashboards.
Leela Eng: when enrichment finishes, send a reassign webhook to set owner to real_owner_id and clear inbound_fallback. endpoint should be idempotent.
Tom - SalesOps: rollout plan: HS sandbox change, SFDC flow mirror, canary in APAC-AU for 48h, metrics: unassigned_count, fallback_rate, reassign_rate, SLA_violations.
Rae (Mktg): add 2h SLA escalation: if still fallback after 2h -> create ticket and page SDR lead. I'll update the playbook and comms.
HubSpot Enricher Bot: enrichment enq-2026-09-14-120 queued.
Tom - SalesOps: will post HS workflow JSON for review later today. :eyes:
Rae (Mktg): thanks everyone 44f scheduling a retro one week post-canary.
